mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_live_recovery_case (case_id, credential_id, symbol, dispatch_key, operation_type, requested_by, evidence_sha256, expected_exchange_order_id, expected_client_order_id, state, created_at) SELECT #{caseId}, g.credential_id, g.symbol, t.idempotency_key, t.operation_type, #{requesterId}, #{evidenceHash}, t.exchange_order_id, t.client_order_id, 'PENDING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.symbol=g.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key WHERE g.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND g.symbol=#{symbol} AND g.active_dispatch_key=#{dispatchKey} AND t.dispatch_status IN ('UNKNOWN','DISPATCHING') AND t.operation_type IN ('OPEN','CLOSE','CANCEL') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_recovery_case c WHERE c.credential_id=g.credential_id AND c.symbol=g.symbol AND c.dispatch_key=t.idempotency_key AND c.state IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') )
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_live_recovery_case SET state='APPROVED', reviewed_by=#{reviewerId}, reviewed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND state='PENDING' AND requested_by<>#{reviewerId} AND evidence_sha256=#{evidenceHash} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.symbol=g.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key WHERE g.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND g.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND g.active_dispatch_key=quant_live_recovery_case.dispatch_key AND t.operation_type=quant_live_recovery_case.operation_type AND t.client_order_id=quant_live_recovery_case.expected_client_order_id AND (t.exchange_order_id <=> quant_live_recovery_case.expected_exchange_order_id) AND t.dispatch_status IN ('UNKNOWN','DISPATCHING') )
mapper.select: SELECT case_id, credential_id, symbol, dispatch_key, operation_type, requested_by, reviewed_by, evidence_sha256, expected_exchange_order_id, expected_client_order_id, state FROM quant_live_recovery_case WHERE case_id=#{caseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_live_recovery_case SET state='EXECUTED', completed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id=#{caseId} AND state='APPROVED' AND evidence_sha256=#{evidenceHash} AND reviewed_by IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_by<>requested_by AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quant_live_dispatch_guard g JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket t ON t.credential_id=g.credential_id AND t.symbol=g.symbol AND t.idempotency_key=g.active_dispatch_key WHERE g.credential_id=quant_live_recovery_case.credential_id AND g.symbol=quant_live_recovery_case.symbol AND g.active_dispatch_key=quant_live_recovery_case.dispatch_key AND t.operation_type=quant_live_recovery_case.operation_type AND t.client_order_id=quant_live_recovery_case.expected_client_order_id AND (t.exchange_order_id <=> quant_live_recovery_case.expected_exchange_order_id) AND t.dispatch_status IN ('DISPATCHING','UNKNOWN') )
